🎖️ How Points Work

📊 10x Scorecard = score × 20 pts (max 100)
🧠 Cognitive Profile = +50 pts
✅ Unit Passed = +100 pts each
📈 Best 2 Unit Avg % adds to total
🔥 Engagement: +2 pts/quiz (max 50)

Example: Scorecard 4.5 = 90 pts · Cognitive = 50 pts · 2 units = 200 pts · 90% avg = 90 pts · 15 quizzes = 30 pts · Total: 460 pts
